title: What is Beneath Misogyny: Misogynous Memes Classification and Explanation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models (combining text and CLIP-ViT image features) on a newly curated dataset of memes (WBMS) to classify misogynistic content across different domains (Kitchen, Leadership, Working, Shopping) and generate explanatory rationales. The evaluation uses F1 scores for classification performance and qualitative metrics (Relevance, Coherence, Readability, and Semantic Similarity) for the generated explanations.
